title: STM32MP2- eMMC Flasher for Mass Production
content:
Hi dear ST team & community,

 

We are planning our mass production strategy for our product using a STM32MP25 MPU. We found that ST’s partner ElProtonic has the GangProgrammer tool. This document https://www.st.com/en/partner-products-and-services/gang-flasher.html mentions it supports MP2s but I got in touch with ElProtonic and they say there’s no currently available support for MP2.

 

We are currently using STM32Prog CLI tool to flash our devices in development but it’s way too slow for mass production. Is there any available/official tool we can use to flash our eMMCs?

 

Or is there any approach you could suggest for us?

Thanks!
